subject: Fix replica node cannot expand dicts when loading legacy RDB (#12839)
reason: The change is a hash-table pre-sizing optimization on a cold path with no externally observable behavior change, so no fuzzer scenario can drive it meaningfully. The only edit is the divisor used by dbExpand in cluster mode: getMyClusterSlotCount() (a replica's own numslots, always 0) becomes getMyShardSlotCount() (its primary's numslots). This is reached only at rdb.c:3266-3274, and only when should_expand_db is still 1 at a key opcode -- i.e. when loading a LEGACY RDB that carries a RESIZEDB hint but no RDB_OPCODE_SLOT_INFO. A modern cluster build always writes SLOT_INFO after RESIZEDB (rdb.
